scheme_name: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship
other_conditions: Candidates in regular employment are not eligible; only women scientists with temporary research or academic positions may apply and must leave earlier assignments if selected.
Positions such as Post‑Doctoral Fellow, Research Associate, etc. are considered temporary assignments.
Applicant must have completed a Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences or an equivalent degree such as MD/MS/MDS.
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹55,000 plus HRA, an annual research grant of ₹2 Lakhs, a field demonstration fund of ₹1 Lakh, and up to ₹2 Lakhs for small equipment.
